description: This Java class 'ConceptAnswersEditor' is a property editor used within the OpenMRS platform to handle lists of 'ConceptAnswer' objects based on string inputs, specifically for converting concept ID strings into corresponding 'ConceptAnswer' objects, managing additions, deletions, and ordering of concept answers, often in the context of form processing or data binding.

classes.name: ConceptAnswersEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for handling lists of concept answers, enabling conversion from string representations of concept IDs and drug IDs to 'ConceptAnswer' objects, and managing the order and presence of answers.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses an input string of concept IDs (possibly with drug IDs), updates the collection of 'ConceptAnswer' objects accordingly, removing deleted answers, adding new ones, and reordering them based on the input sequence.

methods.name: getConceptAnswerFromOriginal
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ConceptAnswer' object from the original collection based on its concept ID.

methods.name: getConceptId
methods.description: Extracts the integer concept ID from a string which may be in 'conceptId' or 'conceptId^drugId' format.

methods.name: getDrugId
methods.description: Extracts the integer drug ID from a string formatted as 'conceptId^drugId' or returns null if not present.
